input.kind: Original project-generated concept image; no external photograph or third-party artwork uploaded

conversion.normalization: Rigid yaw pi and uniform outer X width1; source PBR unchanged
conversion.collisionRepair: Collision copy only: 0.008 normalized cells, one-cell six-neighbour closing then enclosed-volume filling. Large exterior water/cradle remains unfilled.

limits: Single-image reconstruction infers hidden surfaces; this is a fictional titan, not an anatomical scan.
Crossing forearms are fused in source topology. Shared local brace deformation preserves their contact; independent arm twists are deliberately not applied.
Far LOD uses original sampled vertex colors and constant roughness. Near retains source UV and byte-identical source PBR maps.
No treasure is baked into this mesh; actual relic must remain in measured external water, not the solid chest.
